MINUTES

  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  NOVEMBER 2, 2017

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at 6:10
p.m. in the City Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by MAYOR ZERUNYAN.

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan

City Council Members Absent:  Zuckerman

City Staff Present:  City Manager Doug Prichard
  Assistant City Manager Greg Grammer
  Planning Director David Wahba
  Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead
  Community Services Director Andy Clark
  Assistant to the City Manager Alexa Davis

DISCUSSION ITEM: WORKSHOP ON PUBLIC ENGAGEMENT

The City Council heard a presentation from Ryder Smith of Tripepi and Smith regarding the City’s
current public information program, including analytic information on website hits, FaceBook
likes, etc. He also went over the options for additional use of electronic media to reach the public.

Council members stated their ideas on public outreach, its goals and hoped for outcomes.

Discussion ensued regarding the times at which it would be appropriate to simply disseminate
information and the times at which feedback from the public would be solicited.

It was agreed that the City’s website should be the place where the public can obtain official
information and that the other social media platforms should drive traffic to the website.

It was noted that the role of Council Members in public forums such as NextDoor should be to
provide links to official City information resources without commenting on the merits of any
particular issue so as to avoid any Brown Act concerns.

Mr. Smith indicated that the website review would be undertaken shortly.

Following discussion, Council requested that Mr. Smith provide a proposal for adjunct services
to assist staff in handling the City’s public information program, especially as it relates to
electronic media.

ADJOURNED  1
CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
NOVEMBER 2, 2017
 ADJOURNMENT

At 7:40 p.m., MAYOR ZERUNYAN formally adjourned the City Council meeting to an adjourned
meeting scheduled for Wednesday, November 8, 2017 beginning at 6:00 p.m. for the purpose of
conducting a joint City Council/Park and Activities Commission meeting to discuss the City
Celebration.
